Frequency Once per round

Prerequisite You are adjacent to the Den Mother

You hurriedly activate the Den Mother, powering it with your own magic or by throwing its systems into maximum ramming speed.

Attempt a @Check[Crafting], @Check[Thievery], @Check[Arcana], @Check[Nature], @Check[Religion], or @Check[Occultism] check.

The DC can be found in the table below based on your party's APL (check with your GM!).

If you expend a focus point or a spell slot of rank 7 or higher (rank 5 or higher in T4) as part of this action, you get one degree of success better than you roll.

Characters can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} your attempt using @Check[Athletics|options:action:aid] or movement based abilities, but the drill itself is immune to all forced movement and teleportation.

Critical Success The Den Mother whirrs! On it's turn in initiative, it will attempt to drill forward 60 feet.

Success As Critical Success, but it only drills forward 30 feet.

Failure Your efforts fail, but the next PC to attempt this action this round gains a +2 Circumstance bonus.

Critical Failure Something backfires! Future attempts this round to Power the Den Mother this round take a -2 Circumstance penalty.

Note: Multiple successes in a round do not increase the Den Mother's movement speed. Multiple PCs can still attempt this action per round to try and get a Critical Success.
